definitions.window: Pure arithmetic replay of the existing baseline query on recorded actual see pictures and saved flight/profile; no controller/see/RNG invocation.
definitions.fallback: Baseline reachable-ball condition false; exact static fallback reconstructed from its selected window/arrival landmark.
definitions.bodies: All raw-controller body snapshots round-trip through explicit non-finite/undefined encoding; decodeBody before free preview.

refinementWitnesses.interpretation: Raw and contained pursuit ask for nonzero forward/lateral movement; applied World velocity is zero. Teammate spacing is the intervening unconstrained refinement in this no-grip/no-engagement state.
